source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

chapter_binding.tsw_alignment_reason: Pinned 1 John 2:14 includes the children address placed at the end of TSW 2:13. Label-level comparators remain unchanged; compare 2:13–14 together.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps affectionate address, purpose and provision without weakening either statement.
key_decisions.before: My little children, I am writing these things to you so that you may not sin. But if anyone does sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous.
key_decisions.after: My little children, I write these things to you so that you will not sin. But if anyone sins, we have an advocate with the Father: Jesus Christ, the righteous one.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: My little children, I am writing these things to you so that you may not sin. But if anyone does sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the atonement term with an explanatory range in notes and the worldwide scope.
key_decisions.before: He is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only but also for the whole world.
key_decisions.after: He himself is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not only for ours but also for the whole world's.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: He is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only but also for the whole world.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the love-of-God phrase open and links the next verse as the criterion.
key_decisions.before: But whoever keeps his word, in that person the love of God has truly been brought to completion. By this we know that we are in him:
key_decisions.after: But in anyone who keeps his word, the love of God has truly reached its fullness. This is how we know that we are in him:
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: but whoever keeps his word, in him truly the love of God is perfected. By this we know that we are in him:

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps direct address and the stated ground of forgiveness.
key_decisions.before: I am writing to you, little children, because your sins have been forgiven for his name's sake.
key_decisions.after: I write to you, little children, because your sins have been forgiven on account of his name.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: I am writing to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven for his name’s sake.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the specifically named groups and two balanced addresses at the pinned verse boundary.
key_decisions.before: I am writing to you, fathers, because you know the one who is from the beginning. I am writing to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I have written to you, children, because you know the Father.
key_decisions.after: I write to you, fathers, because you have known the one who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: I am writing to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I am writing to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, children, because you know the Father.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the tense shift and all three addresses in the source's verse 14.
key_decisions.before: I have written to you, fathers, because you know the one who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.
key_decisions.after: I have written to you, children, because you have known the Father. I have written to you, fathers, because you have known the one who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, God's word remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God abides in you, and you have overcome the evil one.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains both desires and the worldly-life term, explained in the note.
key_decisions.before: For everything in the world—the desire of the flesh, the desire of the eyes, and the pride of life—is not from the Father but from the world.
key_decisions.after: For everything in the world—the desire of the flesh, the desire of the eyes and pride in one's possessions—is from the world, not from the Father.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For all that is in the world—the desire of the flesh and the desire of the eyes and the pride of life—is not from the Father but is from the world.

key_decisions.rationale: Unpacks the departure clause while documenting the scope of the final all/not expression.
key_decisions.before: They went out from us, but they were not of us. For if they had been of us, they would have remained with us. But they went out so that it might become clear that none of them are of us.
key_decisions.after: They went out from us, but they did not belong to us. If they had belonged to us, they would have remained with us. Their departure made clear that none of them belonged to us.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would have remained with us. But they went out, that it might become plain that they all are not of us.

key_decisions.rationale: Follows the pinned all of you rather than all things and leaves the Holy One unnamed.
key_decisions.before: But you have an anointing from the Holy One, and all of you know.
key_decisions.after: But you have an anointing from the Holy One, and all of you know.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But you have been anointed by the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the difficult no-teacher claim and repeated anointing without resolving its scope by added explanation.
key_decisions.before: But the anointing you received from him remains in you, and you do not need anyone to teach you. Rather, as his anointing teaches you about all things and is true and is not a lie, just as it taught you, remain in him.
key_decisions.after: As for you, the anointing you received from him remains in you, and you do not need anyone to teach you. His anointing teaches you about all things; it is true and is no lie. So remain in him, just as it taught you.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But the anointing that you received from him abides in you, and you have no need that anyone should teach you. But as his anointing teaches you about all things, and is true and is not a lie—just as it has taught you, abide in him.
